synthesis.reasoning: Both macro and micro forecasts converge on an identical 7-day warming trajectory from the current cool, wet baseline (28.2°C, 77% humidity, 10.3mm rain). The macro view emphasizes the seasonal cooling trend bottoming out in late September with a gradual rebound, while the micro view details the 3-5 day oscillation cycle driven by rain/humidity events, noting the current 3-day warming trend (27.8→28.2°C) and historical analogs (Sep 1-4, Sep 14-16) showing 1-1.5°C rises over 3-4 days post-rain. High confidence in Days 1-3 (continuation of observed trend + strong historical precedent); moderate confidence in Days 4-7 (dependent on timing of next rain system, but consistent with multiple prior warm pulses peaking near 30°C).
